buyer_hypothesis: Small research team with a defined experiment, nominal resource access and unresolved institutional/data/method prerequisites
independent_value: A source-bound conditional route and explicit missing permissions for the buyer to review, even if the larger venture stops. Usefulness beyond provider assistance is unvalidated.
eligible_inputs: One permission-cleared finite brief with up to12 declared steps, evidence for each prerequisite and obligation, and an agreed acceptance rubric. No sensitive data required.
deliverable: Input register, executable conditional route or no-plan/incomplete result, independent finite checks, pending-permission list, cost/time assumptions and correction log
acceptance: All supplied constraints and obligations preserved; complete source bindings; finite checker passes; missing or conflicting evidence disclosed. Requires separate buyer acceptance.

price_hypothesis.basis: One member of the existing400/800/1000/1200 sensitivity family; not an observed price or globally optimal quote
price_hypothesis.status: HOLD; no contract or invoice issued

correction_obligations: Correct errors against the agreed frozen input and rubric before acceptance. Failed or incomplete packets are not invoiced; rescinded acceptance receives the modeled full refund. Changed scope needs new terms.
delivery_limits: Planning packet only. No facility access, experiment results, supplier capacity, legal interpretation, financing, or model performance promise.
necessary_capability_test: Can declared institutional, data and method prerequisites be composed into a checkable route while preserving every obligation?
alternatives: Ordinary library containing the same asset
commercial_gate: Actual brief, rights, demand, buyer acceptance, complete measured costs and agreed terms missing; no sale established.
